cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Yes, Under My Physics
cards.instruction: Agree completely, then redefine each term using rules that make your preferred outcome inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Absolutely, I'll move forward for the photo. Forward means facing the camera; I'm perfectly placed in this shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need you two feet closer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Certainly. Feet are units of zoom. Increase yours by two.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A full portrait means all the important parts. You've captured me completely.

mechanism: A agrees to its photography pupil requests but teaches self-serving definitions that keep A in the shade.
confusable: Not an outright refusal or simple misunderstanding: explicit agreement is followed by a new meaning for the pupil term each time.
comparison: Subject controls photograph through definitions versus helper avoids carrying through redefinitions.
seedUse: D167 photo/forward/feet/zoom/full portrait; S05 former composition teacher.
